title: Alleged Suspect in the Murder of Clara Brugada’s Aides Arrested in Morelos
author: Nayelli Ramírez
content:
_This article by Nayelli Ramírez originally appeared in the[June 29, 2026
edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/06/29/capital/detienen-en-
morelos-a-presunto-implicado-en-el-asesinato-de-colaboradores-de-clara-
brugada), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** The investigations into the murder of two aides of the head
of government, Clara Brugada, made it possible to locate and arrest in
Yautepec, Morelos, Jovany "N", an alleged member of the criminal cell linked
to the attack, the Attorney General's Office reported.

In a statement, the agency detailed that the capture was the result of the
exchange of information and the intelligence work carried out with the
Secretariat of Security and Citizen Protection (SSPC), the Secretariat of
Citizen Security (SSC), and the National Intelligence Center (CNI). During the
operation a short firearm, a gram scale, and a bag with doses of drugs were
seized from him.

He was subsequently placed at the disposal of the Public Prosecutor's Office
of the Attorney General's Office of the Republic (FGR).

The authorities noted that the investigations continue in order to arrest the
rest of the people involved in the double homicide and to prevent the case
from going unpunished.
